vo.en: You can't lift your ring finger.

visual.description: A man's hand spread flat on a dark, textured wooden table.

vo.en: Put your palm flat. Now, tuck your middle finger all the way under so your knuckle touches the table.

visual.description: Close-up shot of a hand tucking the middle finger underneath the palm while others stay flat.

vo.en: Try to lift your ring finger while keeping the others down. It won't move. It's like it's glued there.

visual.description: Macro view of a ring finger attempting to lift but failing to move off the surface.

vo.en: Wait, here is the creepy part. Lift your index finger. Now lift your pinky. They move fine, but your ring finger is dead.

visual.description: A hand demonstrating that the index and pinky fingers can lift easily while the middle is tucked.

vo.en: The science is simple. Your middle and ring fingers share the same extensor tendon. They are physically linked.

visual.description: A 3D medical animation showing the internal structure of a human hand and its tendons.

vo.en: Tucking one finger literally locks the other in place. It's an anatomical deadbolt hiding in your own hand.

visual.description: A close-up of a heavy metal door bolt sliding into a locked position.

vo.en: Subscribe for more daily body hacks and comment STUCK if this worked on you. This is exactly why...

visual.description: A man looking at his hand with a surprised expression before looking into the lens.
